Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the comparison logic, stating “The film with the larger age value has the younger director.” This is false—larger age means older, not younger. The correct criterion is later birth year (or smaller age at release) indicates the younger director. This error could directly lead to selecting the wrong film.
